<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="360" height="800" viewBox="0 0 360 800">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.9" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#172321"/>
      <stop offset="0.48" stop-color="#000000"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#243735"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="panel" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#728887"/>
      <stop offset="0.48" stop-color="#465454"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#111817"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="orb" cx="50%" cy="42%" r="65%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#d9ffff"/>
      <stop offset="0.24" stop-color="#7EC0F6"/>
      <stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#728887"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#172321"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="170%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="8" stdDeviation="8" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".7"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="soft" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="14"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="360" height="800" fill="url(#bg)"/>
  <ellipse cx="185" cy="306" rx="145" ry="175" fill="#728887" opacity=".12" filter="url(#soft)"/>
  <ellipse cx="305" cy="105" rx="100" ry="95" fill="#7EC0F6" opacity=".08" filter="url(#soft)"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="18" y="18" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <line x1="286" y1="13" x2="286" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="290" y1="11" x2="290" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="294" y1="9" x2="294" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="307" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="307" y1="14" x2="310" y2="11" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="321" y="8" width="20" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="323" y="10" width="15" height="7" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="342" y="11" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- branded header -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="31" cy="57" r="17" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <polygon points="31,43 34,53 42,57 34,60 31,71 28,60 20,57 28,53" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="57" y="62" font-family="Nobile" font-size="22" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Mercedes-Benz</text>
    <line x1="57" y1="69" x2="195" y2="69" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="48" x2="340" y2="48" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="55" x2="340" y2="55" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="62" x2="340" y2="62" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- greeting and status chip -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="105" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".72">Good morning, Alex</text>
    <rect x="242" y="89" width="94" height="25" rx="13" fill="#465454" stroke="#728887" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="257" cy="101" r="4" fill="#7EC0F6"/>
    <text x="267" y="106" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Ready to listen</text>
  </g>

  <!-- assistant image area -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="130" width="312" height="302" rx="23" fill="url(#panel)" stroke="#728887" stroke-opacity=".5" stroke-width="1"/>
    <ellipse cx="180" cy="278" rx="112" ry="105" fill="#000000" opacity=".27"/>
    <circle cx="180" cy="275" r="86" fill="url(#orb)" opacity=".95"/>
    <circle cx="180" cy="275" r="63" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".48" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="180" cy="275" r="42" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".25" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="180" cy="275" r="13" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".9"/>
    <circle cx="180" cy="275" r="6" fill="#7EC0F6"/>
    <polygon points="72,352 126,300 158,329 195,286 286,368" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".08"/>
    <circle cx="275" cy="177" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".22"/>
    <circle cx="91" cy="195" r="4" fill="#7EC0F6" opacity=".8"/>
    <text x="180" y="166" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".72">MERCEDES INTELLIGENCE</text>
    <text x="180" y="404" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".78">Your personal driving companion</text>
  </g>

  <!-- prompt -->
  <g>
    <text x="180" y="472" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nobile" font-size="26" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Say “Hello Mercedes!”</text>
    <text x="180" y="497" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".62">Ask for directions, music, or vehicle controls</text>
  </g>

  <!-- microphone activation button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <circle cx="180" cy="559" r="39" fill="#728887"/>
    <circle cx="180" cy="559" r="32" fill="#465454" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".28" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="173" y="542" width="14" height="27" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="166,558 166,563 168,570 173,575 180,577 187,575 192,570 194,563 194,558" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="180" y1="577" x2="180" y2="584" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="173" y1="584" x2="187" y2="584" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- quick actions -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="626" width="96" height="46" rx="13" fill="#465454" stroke="#728887" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="649" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="46" y1="649" x2="46" y2="643" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="46" y1="649" x2="51" y2="652" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="61" y="654" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Recent</text>

    <rect x="132" y="626" width="96" height="46" rx="13" fill="#465454" stroke="#728887" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polygon points="154,640 165,646 154,652" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="168" y1="640" x2="168" y2="653" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="179" y="654" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Media</text>

    <rect x="240" y="626" width="96" height="46" rx="13" fill="#728887"/>
    <circle cx="262" cy="649" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="262" y1="638" x2="262" y2="660" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="251" y1="649" x2="273" y2="649" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="278" y="654" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Explore</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="702" width="360" height="98" fill="#000000" opacity=".78"/>
  <line x1="18" y1="702" x2="342" y2="702" stroke="#728887" stroke-opacity=".42" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="36,730 47,721 58,730 58,742 51,742 51,734 43,734 43,742 36,742" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="47" y="762" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" fill="#FFFFFF">Home</text>

    <circle cx="128" cy="731" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#728887" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="128" y1="721" x2="128" y2="741" stroke="#728887" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="118" y1="731" x2="138" y2="731" stroke="#728887" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="128" y="762" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".62">Vehicle</text>

    <rect x="196" y="722" width="20" height="15" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#728887" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polygon points="201,737 201,742 207,737" fill="#728887"/>
    <circle cx="202" cy="729" r="1.2" fill="#728887"/>
    <circle cx="207" cy="729" r="1.2" fill="#728887"/>
    <circle cx="212" cy="729" r="1.2" fill="#728887"/>
    <text x="206" y="762" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".62">Messages</text>

    <circle cx="296" cy="728" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#728887" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="296" cy="741" rx="12" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#728887" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="296" y="762" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".62">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <line x1="145" y1="787" x2="215" y2="787" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".75"/>
</svg>
